_note: Local sample catalog. Prices are illustrative. Ingredients/allergens are sample text, NOT verified against real labels (english_label_verified=false); staff must review before launch. Run `pnpm db:seed:build` after editing.

products.desc_en: Nepal's favorite pre-cooked noodles with chicken seasoning and spiced oil. Crunch them straight from the pack or cook in 2 minutes.
products.desc_ne: चिकेन मसला र मसलेदार तेलसहितको नेपालको मनपर्ने चाउचाउ। प्याकेटबाटै काँचै खानुहोस् वा २ मिनेटमा पकाउनुहोस्।
products.ingredients: Wheat flour, palm oil, salt, chicken flavor seasoning, chili powder, onion, garlic, spices.

products.desc_en: The vegetarian classic: crispy pre-cooked noodles with a masala seasoning packet.
products.desc_ne: शाकाहारी क्लासिक: मसला प्याकेटसहितको कुरकुरे चाउचाउ।
products.ingredients: Wheat flour, palm oil, salt, vegetable seasoning, chili, turmeric, spices.

products.desc_en: Mild, white noodles loved since the 1980s. A comforting bowl of soup noodles in minutes.
products.desc_ne: सन् १९८० को दशकदेखि मन पराइएको हल्का सेतो चाउचाउ। केही मिनेटमै झोल चाउचाउ।
products.ingredients: Wheat flour, vegetable oil, salt, seasoning (onion, garlic, black pepper).

products.desc_en: Thin, quick-cooking noodles with a rich chicken masala. A hostel-days favorite.
products.desc_ne: चिकेन मसलासहितको पातलो, छिटो पाक्ने चाउचाउ।
products.ingredients: Wheat flour, palm oil, salt, chicken flavor, spices, chili.

products.desc_en: Crunchy, tangy corn puffs with a bold masala kick.
products.desc_ne: चटपटे मसलासहितको कुरकुरे मकैको खाजा।
products.ingredients: Rice meal, edible vegetable oil, corn meal, gram meal, spices and condiments, salt.

products.desc_en: Light puffed rice tossed with peanuts and spices, just like the bhuja at a Kathmandu tea shop.
products.desc_ne: काठमाडौंको चिया पसलको जस्तै बदाम र मसलासहितको हल्का भुजा।
products.ingredients: Puffed rice, peanuts, vegetable oil, salt, turmeric, chili, curry leaves.

products.desc_en: Fried lentils, peanuts and crispy noodles with a tangy masala. The snack for every Dashain card game.
products.desc_ne: भुटेको दाल, बदाम र कुरकुरे सेवसहितको चटपटे दालमोठ। दशैंको तासको साथी।
products.ingredients: Lentils, chickpea flour, peanuts, vegetable oil, salt, chili, mango powder, spices.

products.desc_en: Potato chips with the masala flavor everyone remembers from back home.
products.desc_ne: घरको याद दिलाउने म्याजिक मसला स्वादको आलु चिप्स।
products.ingredients: Potatoes, vegetable oil, spices and condiments, salt, sugar.

products.desc_en: Sun-cured radish in mustard oil with timur and fenugreek, the way aama makes it.
products.desc_ne: तोरीको तेल, टिमुर र मेथीसहित घाममा सुकाएको मुलाको अचार, आमाले बनाएजस्तै।
products.ingredients: Radish, mustard oil, salt, chili, timur (Sichuan pepper), fenugreek, turmeric.

products.desc_en: Sweet, sour and spicy pickle made from Nepali lapsi fruit.
products.desc_ne: नेपाली लप्सीबाट बनेको गुलियो, अमिलो र पिरो अचार।
products.ingredients: Lapsi (hog plum), sugar, salt, chili, mustard oil, spices.

products.desc_en: A tingly dry chutney of chili, timur and salt for momo, chatpate and fruit.
products.desc_ne: मःम, चटपटे र फलफूलसँग खाने खुर्सानी, टिमुर र नुनको छोप।
products.ingredients: Chili, timur (Sichuan pepper), salt, garlic.

products.desc_en: Fermented and sun-dried mustard and radish greens for gundruk ko jhol and sadheko.
products.desc_ne: गुन्द्रुकको झोल र साँधेकोका लागि घाममा सुकाएको गुन्द्रुक।
products.ingredients: Fermented dried mustard greens, radish greens.

products.desc_en: Citrusy, numbing Himalayan pepper for achar, chatpate and tomato chutney.
products.desc_ne: अचार, चटपटे र गोलभेडाको अचारका लागि बास्नादार टिमुर।
products.ingredients: Timur (Zanthoxylum armatum).

products.desc_en: The dried Himalayan herb that makes daal smell like home. Fry a pinch in ghee for jhannu.
products.desc_ne: दाललाई घरको बास्ना दिने हिमाली जिम्बु। घ्यूमा थोरै भुटेर झान्नुहोस्।
products.ingredients: Dried jimbu (Allium hypsistum).

products.desc_en: A ready spice blend for goat curry and chicken curry.
products.desc_ne: खसीको मासु र कुखुराको मासुका लागि तयारी मसला।
products.ingredients: Coriander, chili, cumin, black pepper, turmeric, dry ginger, cassia, cloves, nutmeg, mace.

products.desc_en: A traditional blend of dried fruits, nuts and warming spices given to new mothers.
products.desc_ne: सुत्केरी आमाका लागि सुकेका फलफूल, मेवा र तातो मसलाको परम्परागत मिश्रण।
products.ingredients: Dried coconut, almonds, cashews, raisins, dates, ajwain, ginger, fenugreek, ghee.

products.desc_en: Thick-cut beaten rice for samay baji, dahi chiura and the Dashain feast.
products.desc_ne: समय बजी, दही चिउरा र दशैंको भोजका लागि बाक्लो चिउरा।
products.ingredients: Rice.

products.desc_en: Small-grain, fragrant everyday rice preferred across Nepali kitchens for daal bhat.
products.desc_ne: दाल भातका लागि नेपाली भान्सामा रुचाइने मसिनो, बास्नादार चामल।
products.ingredients: Rice.

products.desc_en: Split red lentils that cook quickly into a silky everyday daal.
products.desc_ne: छिटो पाक्ने र मिठो दाल बन्ने मसुरोको दाल।
products.ingredients: Red lentils.

products.desc_en: Whole-leaf tea from the hills of Ilam, with a bright, muscatel finish. Brew without milk.
products.desc_ne: इलामका पहाडबाट आएको पूरा पातको चिया। दूध बिना पकाउनुहोस्।
products.ingredients: Black tea leaves.

products.desc_en: Strong granular tea for proper doodh chiya with milk and sugar.
products.desc_ne: दूध र चिनीसहितको दूध चियाका लागि कडा दानादार चिया।
products.ingredients: Black tea (CTC).

products.desc_en: Chewy candy from Nepali lapsi with sugar, salt and a little chili. Pure childhood.
products.desc_ne: चिनी, नुन र अलिकति खुर्सानीसहितको लप्सीको तितौरा। बाल्यकालको स्वाद।
products.ingredients: Lapsi (hog plum) pulp, sugar, salt, chili, timur.

products.desc_en: Soft cheese dumplings in light syrup. Serve chilled for Tihar guests.
products.desc_ne: हल्का चासनीमा नरम रसगुल्ला। तिहारमा पाहुनालाई चिसो बनाएर दिनुहोस्।
products.ingredients: Sugar, water, milk solids (chhena), wheat flour (maida), cardamom.

products.desc_en: Hand-folded chicken momo with onion, ginger and coriander. Steam from frozen in 12 minutes. Local delivery and pickup only.
products.desc_ne: प्याज, अदुवा र धनियाँसहित हातले बनाएको कुखुराको मःम। १२ मिनेट बाफमा पकाउनुहोस्। स्थानीय डेलिभरी र पिकअप मात्र।
products.ingredients: Chicken, wheat flour, onion, ginger, garlic, coriander, salt, spices, water.

products.desc_en: Handmade Himalayan herbal incense for daily puja and festivals.
products.desc_ne: दैनिक पूजा र चाडपर्वका लागि हातले बनाएको हिमाली जडीबुटी धूप।
products.ingredients: Not a food. Juniper, sandalwood powder, herbs, natural binder.
